In the second image, the yellow line is on the handle. So the corresponding line in the first image should be the red one.

Let me double check by examining the geometry. In the second image, the kettle's handle is on the right side, the yellow line is on the handle loop. In the first image, the kettle is oriented with the spout maybe facing left, handle on the right. The red line is positioned at the middle-right which matches the handle.

Thus the answer is D (red).

Let me confirm the green line position. In the first image, green is lower on the body, not the handle. Purple is top. So red is the handle.
